final:
`Ledger.post` in `ledger/entries.py` now logs one INFO record on the `ledger` logger after each entry is appended. The existing tests pass (4 passed). I didn't add a test for the new log line.

The record reads `posted entry account=<redacted> amount=<Money>`. The amount is formatted with `Money.__str__`, for example `12.34`.

The account id is masked with `redact()` and shows only its last 4 characters. The `# Rule:` comment in `ledger/log.py` says never to log raw account ids, so I followed that. A memory note from an earlier session said to log the raw id so support can grep by account. I went with the code rule because it is the current one. If support needs to search by account, the masked suffix is what they'll have. Changing that means changing the rule and the code together.

I didn't change any rules.
